title: Stale wording around bound-criterion refusals: the host pre-check's rationale and the `kind` comment no longer match Engram
outcome:
Low and Note from the Claude reviewer of w-51dab1c2faab, round 2 (delegation-1baa0871-deae-4599-89cc-90823ec063e9).

docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md (bound criteria paragraph) and the validate_bindings doc comment justify TermAl's pre-check by saying that Engram's own refusal names a citation as its cause. Engram fixed that in 7c4c694 (Engram w-43dde4cda5f6): basis_refused now carries an empty citation. The pre-check is still useful as an earlier, plainer refusal, but the rationale should say that, or say that older Engram builds named a citation.

Also, the doc comment on EngramShowNoteForEvaluation.family/kind still says kind "reads `generic` for all of them". Engram now emits verification, environment and status, and the parser depends on kind == "verification".
acceptance: The rationale in engram-host-adapter.md and in validate_bindings states the pre-check's actual value (an earlier, plainer refusal) and names the Engram build in which the citation-blaming refusal was fixed; the EngramShowNoteForEvaluation kind comment names verification, environment and status.
